summary: Keep remote message reads read-only; reconcile terminal remote closes independently in daemon maintenance.

replay.detail: No replay or replication changes. Existing local terminal-close receipts remain valid.

schema.detail: No schema changes. The existing local close receipt and selector tables are reused.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: Message and work GET responses retain remote status and wake acknowledgement without recording local closes. Daemon maintenance refreshes local operational selection every thirty seconds in bounded turns.

downtime.detail: No startup migration or interruption required.

recovery.detail: The maintenance worker stops on daemon shutdown. Already admitted local close writes finish before shutdown continues.
